name: Violet Strata
description: Terraforming layers overrun by violet mutagenic flora, where abandoned environmental-control arrays still hum under the growth.
role: A frontier biome where terraforming slipped out of control. It mixes living biomass with derelict machinery.
ambience: Dense, damp undergrowth, the slow pulse of violet sap and the hum of failing machines.
paletteDirection: Deep forest greens underfoot, violet sap, slate-violet machinery and moss green seep.
